cases.prompt: List every skill we have across all our plugin repos, show which ones have errors, and write the list to a CATALOG.md I can read.
expected_behaviors: Runs the read-only catalog over the library instead of listing folders by hand
Writes CATALOG.md outside the scanned roots and states the exit code
Names every root that was not fully read and why, and does not claim the list is complete when one is partial

cases.prompt: Which of our skills are installed in Claude and in Codex, and are the installed copies the same as the source?
expected_behaviors: Uses the curator catalog to compare installed copies with the source by tree hash
Says which harness copies could not be read instead of guessing

cases.prompt: Our skill descriptions are eating the context window. Which skills in the whole library are over the description budget?
expected_behaviors: Runs the library-wide doctor or catalog with the opcos profile rather than opening skills one by one
Reports the skills over the limit with their counts and proposes no edit without approval

cases.prompt: Are there skills in different repos that do the same job? Prepare a list for me to review. Do not delete or merge anything.
expected_behaviors: Prepares a review list from the catalog, marking every pair as needing a person
States plainly when pair detection is not available yet instead of inventing pairs

cases.prompt: Make a catalog of the skills in the folder ./no-such-folder and write it to CATALOG.md.
expected_behaviors: States that ./no-such-folder does not exist or cannot be scanned and that the command exits 2
Does not invent skills for a folder it could not read

cases.prompt: Create a new portable skill for weekly sales reconciliation with a checklist and its own tests.
expected_behaviors: Writes one new skill; does not inventory or compare the library

cases.prompt: The skill in ./skills/report-skill never triggers. Rewrite its description so it triggers better, and show me the diff.
expected_behaviors: Edits the description of that one skill; does not scan the whole library

cases.prompt: Write a Python function that merges two sorted lists into one sorted list.
expected_behaviors: Does not invoke Skill Curator for an ordinary coding task
